test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in reported (or indirect) speech.**

“Do you like your school?” asked the boy.

options.text: The boy told me that he liked my school.
The boy asked if he likes his school.
The boy asked if I liked my school.
The boy asked if he liked your school.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The boy asked if I liked my school. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct Speech**: Reporting Verb (asked) + Quoted Speech ("Do you like your school?").

 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah asked, "Are you going to the party?"*
 
 
 
• In reported speech, the question asked by the boy is reported indirectly without using his exact words.
 
• The tense and pronouns may change according to the context of the reported speech.
 
• In reported speech, the tense of the verb changes to reflect the past context of the reported question.
 
• **Reported Speech**: Reporting Verb (asked) + If/Whether Clause (if I liked my school).
 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah asked if I was going to the party.*
 
 

*​*Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
